### An Imperfect Reconciliation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/imperfect-reconciliation
Passage: 2 Samuel 14:28
Points:
- David's past sin weakened his spiritual discernment and severely damaged his family relationships.
- Although David allowed Absalom back to Jerusalem, he kept him banished from his presence for two full years.
- Desperate to break the stalemate, Absalom burned Joab's barley field to force an audience with the king.
- The incomplete, superficial reconciliation between father and son allowed Absalom's bitterness to fester into future rebellion.
- When pursuing peace with a willing party, believers should seek complete and genuine reconciliation rather than half-measures.
